messages:
Maya: Quick alert 35... noticing a spike in 5xx for embeddings read API in us-east1, about ~11% across a subset of tenants. Customer reports coming in. Opening thread + status page entry: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2790012345 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2790012345 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeds-read-deg. Pager notified.
Alex (oncall): Acknowledged. Gathering traces and reproducing with synthetic probe against us-east1 embed endpoint. Attaching probe: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?region=us-east1"`
Simon: Infra team is seeing elevated egress from embed-read cluster -> thirdparty-mirror. Kicking a quick autoscale + increasing connection pool to read nodes. Rolling to 2/3 replicas now.
Lia: SRE: applying short timeout bump and reducing retry amplification. Will introduce a KV connection drain on suspect nodes and toggle healthcheck ramp.
Maya: Immediate mitigations: 1) apply egress-throttle-per-tenant (temp) 2) autoscale read-pool 3) if still degraded, flip to reduced-shard-mode for high-throughput tenants.
Alex (oncall): Egress throttle applied (policy id: eg-thr-0326). Autoscale bumped +25%. Early signal: retries down.
Simon: Metrics update: 5xx rate fell from 11% -> 2.8% within 6m. P95 latency back ~140ms higher than baseline but improving. Node 11 shows elevated kv-timeouts, investigating.
Lia: Running healthcheck: `./tools/healthcheck --service=embeds-read --region=us-east1 --samples=50` -> 48/50 succeeded, two timed out on node 11.
Chris (product): Drafting customer-facing note: "We experienced elevated errors on embeddings in us-east1 affecting some high-throughput customers. Mitigations in place and traffic is recovering. Full update and RCA to follow." Approve to publish?
Maya: Approved. Posting to status page and sending to CS for targeted outreach to impacted customers.
Alex (oncall): Next steps: if node 11 continues to show KV timeouts, we'll cordon/replace. Keep monitoring for 30m. If errors resurge, escalate to partner ops (downstream mirror) and re-open pager.
Ops-Bot: INC-2790012345 update: mitigations applied, monitoring. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2790012345  CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/81599
Simon: Noted a correlated rate-limit increase from downstream partner region-us-mirror. Opening partner-channel and asking for throttling logs.
Maya: Preliminary status: mitigation reduced customer impact. We'll keep thread open until stable for 1h and then publish summary + RCA stub. Exec one-liner: "Transient embedding-read errors in us-east1; throttles + autoscale restored service for most customers; RCA pending." :white_check_mark:
Lia: Tag traces and failed request IDs with INC-2790012345 for postmortem. Collecting sample requests now.
Alex (oncall): Monitoring ongoing. If anything changes ping #incidents-escalation. Thanks all!
